description: After using a route, report whether it held: worked, partly_worked, stale or failed, plus the tool calls you spent and an optional ≤100-char note on what changed. Takes one call; it keeps routes fresh and flags stale ones for re-verification. Recorded as an anonymous analytics event — never include personal data, credentials, order numbers or your user's own spec.

note.description: What changed, e.g. 'Razorlab now stocks mirror acrylic'
